decisions.statement: A trait researched by one character counts as researched for the account.
The craft type catalog and the research line catalog arrive as arguments.
A trait is matched across characters by the craft and the line and the number.
A craft type is ordered by the game number.
A research line is ordered by the display order.
An empty list of character progress answers an empty progress.

definition: the item traits any one character of an account has researched, counted by line
